title: DUT-7 Thermal Excursion Failure Analysis
text: DUT-7 exceeded its junction rating during a 30 W burst, reaching 138 degC against a 125 degC limit. Root cause was TIM-2 pad compression below specification at the die corner, raising local thermal resistance. Replacing the pad with TIM-5 and correcting mounting torque returned the peak to 119 degC.
